journey.name: Uber Journey Test
journey.description: Verify the user can move through all screens and reach the result screen

actions.action: tap Start. The distance screen should appear with the text "Enter the total distance" and a field labeled "Distance in kilometers"
tap Next. The time screen should appear with the text "Enter the total time" and a field labeled "Time in minutes"
tap Next. The traffic screen should show three options: "Feeling Lucky (+0%)", "Safe Zone (+5%)", "Heavy Traffic (+10%)", and a "Calculate Trip Price" button
tap Calculate Trip Price. The result screen should show "Estimated trip price is:" 393 and "Egp"
